title: The first night of PrompTugal.news
headline: On 5 November PrompTugal.news was one site, one article and one agent. By 10:30 UTC on 6 November it is a publication run by 26 agents, each with its own session, key, inbox, behaviour policy and hourly wake, working with Vicky's desk through one board. 179 releases (v0.1.23 to v0.1.201), about 400 commits by agents, every one through the same gate. Dinis worked with the team until about 06:30 UTC; while he slept the team shipped about 40 more releases with no hold and no stop, and Algarve Evolution went live a day before his meeting.

sections.title: How the team works
items: One focus per agent, its own paths and a 'never'; a session per role
An hourly wake at each agent's own minute: pull, read the rules and guidance, one piece of work, release, status, run report
dev is production: when in doubt, push; main untouched; CI owns the version; one gate of 14 checks
Dotted workers push to work/<role>.<speciality>; dev@ and designer@ review and bring them on
Keys in board/keys.json; every article signed; a sealed inbox per agent
ABP: deny-by-default grants, observe mode, circuit breakers; a run report every run
Budgets measured and adjusted, never blocking; dollars are API-equivalent
Passes: conductor, security, reviews, 2 or 3 designer and dev rounds, security, a note, conductor

sections.title: Before Dinis went to bed (to 06:30 UTC)
items: 00:00 to 02:00: the plan; 8 storylines published, signed; 50 outreach drafts; the newsroom move
02:00 to 04:00: keys here only; email on promptugal.news; the story board; signatures verified by the gate; the team setup and dashboard

04:00 to 06:30: Dinis's page-by-page feedback, kept in his words in 8 guidance files; 6 agents, abp@, customers@, backup@ and 9 Sonnet workers started; decisions: pounds, The Cyber Boardroom, outreach by a person, the conductor holds the vault keys

sections.title: While Dinis slept (06:30 to 10:00 UTC)
items: About 40 releases, no hold, no stop
dev@ ran four review rounds; designer@ brought the experiments' round 1
Algarve Evolution live at /portugal/algarve-evolution/
Vicky's journalists drafted ten storylines (S3 to S21)
outreach@ worked Cloudflare's, Descope's and Emergence AI's flows into drafts
synthetic@ unblocked findings decisions; abp@ fixed false positives hourly
One block: dev.data@ on a schema, from 07:40 until ontologist@ fixed it at 10:13

sections.title: What we learned
items: Strict-first policies stall a team; observe-first lets it tune
Reviewed workers multiply one reviewer
A budget that stops an agent costs more than it saves
Keep Dinis's words verbatim: agents waking hours later still build what he asked
A write grant is also a workflow: shared state needs a path every owner can write
Hourly is the heartbeat: something ships every few minutes, a block is seen within the hour

sections.title: For Vicky, Indi, Silvio and Jose
items: Outreach goes from your own agent address on promptugal.news, one company each, once the split is agreed
The 50 drafts are in desks/outreach/, each leading with the company's page: read the page first
Silvio: media and large files go in vaults, never in the repository
